description: Send a message to the buyer in a conversation, as the seller. It is delivered to a real person and cannot be unsent, so send only text the user has asked for or approved. Some marketplaces deliver it within a minute rather than instantly; the result says which.

ref.description: The `ref` of a conversation from list_buyer_conversations.

text.description: The message, plain text, at most 2,000 characters.

name: reply_to_buyer
